title: Peruvian government shifts to tacit endorsement of University of Ica research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Peruvian government shifts to tacit endorsement of University of Ica research, about 2024 at University of Ica, Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Peruvian government was completely against this case, especially up until September 2024 when they started to tacitly endorse research at the University of Ica that might actually indicate that these bodies are real.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a set of small three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru. He says the Peruvian government was completely against the case until September 2024, when it began quietly backing research at the University of Ica that might show the bodies are real. He tells it as a sign that official attitudes toward the bodies may be shifting.
